decision.summary: Accept and disclose: the current verified selected seed-13 corpora are accepted for the exploratory scope30-v1 study without regeneration, relabelling or row deletion; known problems are retained and disclosed.

issue11_evidence.note: model-assisted (Claude Opus 5.5) and heuristic findings; not independent-human judgments

scope_scan_curated.note: reviewer's reading of the heuristic candidates (Claude Opus 5.5); NOT recorded review judgments

limitations: Corrected TREC AugGPT (ADR 0013 v2) passed the formal round-2 screen with 1/10 clear errors and 3 ambiguous (two-clear-errors trigger not reached); the clear error trec.train.04163.seed13.aug4 changes the named entity 'Hot Wheels' to 'Hot and Wheels'.
The targeted re-check of the 10 round-1 IDs found trec.train.00845.seed13.aug3 still changes the expected answer type (description to a named event); this re-check is outside the random denominator.

A read-only heuristic scope scan found approximately 13 likely problematic TREC AugGPT rows plus 6 borderline rows of 360: answer-type changes, corrupted entity or text names (appearing only in the v2 output), a reversed relation and abbreviation questions drifting toward definition requests. Around 3-4 of these rows may change the intended label or answer type.
All 12 Emotion AugGPT paraphrases of emotion.train.07790 and emotion.train.15223 change the source meaning (agent reversal; third-party strength made self-attributed) while retaining their labels.

These rows are retained, not relabelled, deleted, corrected or hidden. They are accepted only for the exploratory scope30-v1, seed-13 study and are not described as harmless or scientifically negligible.

All findings are model-assisted (Claude Opus 5.5; one judgment per item) or heuristic. They are not independent-human judgments, human agreement, or population error estimates, and ten-row batches cannot estimate corpus error rates.

The freeze does not establish corpus correctness, semantic quality, robustness, statistical stability or generalization. Other disclosed #11 flags (ambiguous rows, Emotion style mismatch and inherited weak source labels, 18 TREC texts shared by selected zero- and few-shot corpora, few-shot labelling cost) remain as recorded in docs/reviews/issue11/README.md.
